recognize_zh: 箭頭處的紅血球幾乎被一個圓形、實心的寄生蟲填滿，胞質內散佈金褐色瘧色素（hemozoin），一側有粉紅色染色質團，不見分裂成裂殖子，符合間日瘧配子體（gametocyte）。
features: Round, compact parasite nearly filling a slightly enlarged red cell
No segmentation into merozoites (not a schizont)
describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows normocytic erythrocytes with scattered platelets. One slightly enlarged red cell is almost completely occupied by a round, unsegmented parasite containing abundant dispersed golden-brown pigment and an eccentric chromatin mass. No merozoites are identified, excluding a mature schizont. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium vivax gametocyte.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum gametocytes are crescent or banana-shaped and distort the red cell, unlike this round gametocyte filling an enlarged cell.
A schizont contains 12-24 discrete merozoites with clumped pigment, whereas this parasite shows a single chromatin mass and no segmentation.
P. malariae gametocytes are similar in shape but fill a normal-sized or small red cell and lack Schüffner stippling; species confirmation may need PCR.
Babesia forms are small pleomorphic rings or tetrads without hemozoin pigment.
